postconditions.expression: all(xor_row(grid, i) == xor_col(grid, i) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: XOR of all elements in a row is the same as the XOR of all elements in the corresponding column for each row and column

postconditions.expression: all(x in grid for x in range(n*n))
postconditions.description: All integers from 0 to (n^2 - 1) appear in the matrix exactly once
